design: 50 frozen primary slots = 5 load tiers x 2 continuation conditions x 5 replicas.
Load tiers: 5k/10k/15k/20k/30k target words; 100/200/300/400/600 synthetic local tasks.
One midpoint at 50%, one primary receipt, paired same-worker reallocation, then E9 close.
Sparse I/O; no per-task GitHub writes; external durable timestamps are primary performance clocks.
If 30k passes, 30k is not declared maximum; next run raises ceiling.
